_comment: Tibik locale file - English (built-in). Copy this file, rename it to your language code (e.g. de.json), translate the values, and drop it into {configPath}/tibik/strings/ on the device. Keys must stay identical to this file. Missing keys fall back to English automatically.
disclaimer.title: Notice
disclaimer.body1: I am Tibik, an independent mod built on Canvas. I am not a replacement for, nor affiliated with, ThatSkyMod (libTSM) and/or thatgamecompany.
compat.shout_disabled: Shout features are disabled because %s was detected.
compat.world_disabled: Teleport features are disabled because %s was detected.
compat.access_disabled: Local position tool is disabled because %s was detected.

access.waiting: Waiting for the game world to finish loading...
access.tp_hint: Type coordinates here or use /tp <x> <y> <z> in the in-game chat.
access.pos_pop_out: Pop out to a floating window
access.ori_drunk_tooltip:
Randomly wobbles your skykid's orientation
with intermittent sober pauses.
access.speed_unavail: Game speed data not available yet
access.netid_hint: Crashes everyone in your instance. One tap, instant, no undo. Only works when others are around. Or just type /rc in the chat.
access.netid_need_instance: Not in an instance with others - nobody to crash yet.
access.netid_unavail: Not connected yet (join an online area first).
access.cinema_unsupported_platform: %s links aren't supported - paste a direct .mp4 or .m3u8 link.
access.cinema_hint: You are not in the Cinema. Video will play but nothing will be visible on-screen. Works for audio-only or radio streams.
access.afk_hook_unavail: AFK hook not available (pattern scan failed)
access.afk_prevent_tooltip:
Resets the idle timer every frame, keeping
your skykid awake (no drowsy pose or zzZ).
access.afk_force_tooltip:
Puts your skykid into AFK state right away.
Disabled while Anti-AFK is active.
access.afk_farm_active: Sky won't collect wax while the kid dozes - AFK locked until the run ends.
access.sq_force_claimable_tooltip:
Forces every seasonal-quest button on Carnival Guide, trust-moment
relive, and other spirit-shop nodes to render as ready-to-claim, and
routes taps onto the HTTP submit branch.  The server still arbitrates
whether to honor the claim; off by default.
access.sq_hook_unavail: Button-gate hook unavailable on this build.
access.broken_neck_tooltip:
Removes the head rotation clamp, allowing the
skykid's head to rotate beyond natural limits.
Visual only - not visible to other players.
access.fpv_tooltip:
First-person view. Places the camera at
the skykid's eye position.
access.skip_cutscenes_tooltip:
Auto-skips cutscenes/timelines the instant they'd start -
skippable and forced (camera-takeover) alike - and stays
on across levels.
access.skip_cutscenes_partial: Forced cutscenes aren't skipped while %s is loaded (skippable ones still are).
access.skip_cutscenes_unavail: Not available on this Sky build.
access.friend_statues_desc: The old 'Friend Statues' from the early Sky beta (Sky: Light Awaits), before the overhead constellation existed. The candles still exist today but are hidden by default; this mod unhides them. Home (CandleSpace) only.
access.friend_statues_tooltip:
Auto-applies on each Home visit; the reveal
isn't saved, so turning it off just stops
re-revealing - statues already shown clear
when Home next reloads (can't be hidden live).
access.friend_statues_unavail: Not available on this Sky build.
buddy.hint: Companion creatures in this level. Toggle Enabled to wake or sleep one (e.g. the prairie dog); tap go to teleport to it.
buddy.toggle_unavail: Enable/disable unavailable on this Sky build (list is read-only).
access.place_anywhere_tooltip: Place props in zones the game normally restricts.
access.bypass_cooldown_tooltip:
Removes the per-use cooldown on inventory items - drop
props or launch fireworks back-to-back without waiting.
access.offline_mode_tooltip:
Isolates you in your own instance - others can't join you and
you can't see them. It disconnects you and keeps you solo (it
beats the auto-reconnect). Turn it off to rejoin normally. Off
by default.
access.offline_mode_unavail: Offline mode is unavailable on this build (pattern scan failed).
access.join_anywhere_tooltip:
Removes the client-side check that blocks joining a friend who
is in a Trial or a level you lack access to. The server can
still refuse (a friend who set themselves non-joinable, or a
full instance). Off by default.
access.join_anywhere_unavail: Join anywhere is unavailable on this build (pattern scan failed).
access.bypass_cooldown_unavailable: Bypass cooldown is unavailable on this build (pattern scan failed).
access.social_offer_description: What action do you want others to offer you?
access.unlock_abilities_tooltip:
On a friend's card, unlocks every action - hug, high-five, duet,
and so on - so you can offer it right away, even ones your
friendship level hasn't reached yet.

Friends only. Turns off when Sky restarts, and nothing is added
to your account.
access.unlock_abilities_unavailable: Not available on this version of Sky.
access.skip_meditation_tooltip:
Instantly completes meditation circles (white pads) so
the triggered action (quest, message, race) fires right
away instead of waiting out the ~5s sit animation.
access.feature_status_pending: Local position tool is waiting for the late init check.
access.feature_status_resolve_failed: Local position tool could not resolve the required game functions.
access.feature_status_unknown: Local position tool status is unknown.

world.w_hint: Tap a destination below or use /w <level_name> in the in-game chat.
world.wp_level_empty: No quick-teleport spots in this level.
world.spawn_status_none: This level does not define a single spawn point, so there is no Spawn button here.
world.spawn_status_unsupported: This game build stores the spawn point somewhere this mod does not recognise (build %u). Please report it.
world.status_pending: Teleport hooks are waiting for the compatibility check.
world.status_install_failed: Teleport hooks could not be installed.
candle.waiting_hint: The candle list populates once the level finishes loading.
candle.group_cluster_tooltip:
Show only one candle per nearby group instead of every candle.
Makes the list easier to skim when a level has many candles close together.
candle.bypass_proximity_tooltip:
Collect wax from any distance the moment a candle is
lit.
candle.all_filtered: All %u slots are disabled and filtered out.
farm.toggle_locked_during_run: Controlled by the run - toggle locked while active.
farm.incl_dyes_tooltip:
After the candle run on each level, teleport to every dye
(butterfly) cluster. Dyes are visited after candles so they
have time to fully stream in.
farm.cluster_radius_tooltip:
Candles within this distance of an already-queued anchor are
skipped (first-candle-wins). Set to 0 to visit every candle.
farm.dye_stream_wait_tooltip:
How long to wait after the candle run before visiting dyes.
Butterflies are lazy-streamed; a longer wait means fewer misses
in large levels.
farm.dye_interval_tooltip:
Dwell time at each dye cluster before moving to the
next.
farm.dye_cluster_radius_tooltip:
Butterflies within this distance of a chosen anchor are skipped.
The game's own pickup radius is 10 u - stay below that to avoid
merging distinct dye spots. 8 u is a safe default.
farm.incl_risky_confirm: Risky realms (e.g. Eden) can damage your avatar mid-run, strand you in sequence-locked content, or trigger first-time reveals. Include them anyway?
farm.incl_risky_tooltip:
Include levels tagged risky (e.g. Eden) in Farm All / From Here.
Risky levels can damage your avatar mid-run, trap you in sequence-locked
content, or teleport to places the game treats as first-time reveals.
Off by default.
farm.incl_wb_tooltip:
After the candle run on each level, collect all available
winged lights before moving on.
farm.incl_dark_plants_tooltip:
On each level, burn all live dark plants after the candle run.
Some dark plants release dye butterflies when killed - enable
'Include dyes' to collect those at the same locations.
Burning is server-visible (other players can see it).
farm.col_candles_tooltip:
Light and collect candles on each level.
Turn this off (with another collectible on) for a
wings-only or dyes-only run. On by default.
farm.nothing_selected_hint: Nothing selected - pick at least one collectible to start.
farm.status_waiting_dyes_stream: Waiting for dyes to stream in...

api.desc: The faster alternative to semi-farm. Pulls all candles from Home - no teleporting, no level loading. Higher detection risk, so use sparingly.
api.auth_required: Sign in before collecting - the API actions need an active session.
api.net_conflict: Another mod (%s) hooked the game's networking before Tibik could. Load Tibik first, or disable that mod.
api.net_unavailable: Tibik couldn't find the game's networking functions on this build - another mod may have hooked them first, or this version isn't supported yet.
api.emitters_tooltip:
Collect today's idle wax spots (Geyser, Grandma,
Forest Bonfire, and similar).
api.claim_races_tooltip:
Claim today's reward for Sunset Race, Fly Race, and Yeti Race.
Server silently skips races already claimed today.
api.daily_quests_tooltip:
Finishes today's daily quests for you and collects all the rewards.
No need to visit the shrine or actually do the quests yourself.
Server silently skips quests already claimed today.
api.wingbuffs_tooltip:
Collects every winged light in the game through the
account API, from wherever you are standing - no
travelling. Already-collected ones are skipped by
the server.
api.wingbuffs_confirm: This grants every winged light in the game at once. It cannot be undone from the mod. Continue?
api.status_done_wingbuffs: Winged lights: %u of %u confirmed by the server.
api.status_done_levels: Done! %u levels collected. Restart Sky to refresh currency.
api.status_done_all: Done! Restart Sky to refresh currency.
api.status_done_daily_quests: Done! %u/%u daily quests claimed (+%u candles). Restart Sky to refresh currency.
api.status_discover_failed: Discovery failed; cannot collect idle wax
api.gift.claim_tooltip:
Claims every pending gift in your Sky inbox (free).
Server-listed; nothing to enable in-game.
api.gift.kindle_tooltip:
Sends a daily friend-star kindle (free) to every friend whose name you've unlocked.
Server caps the daily count.
api.gift.hearts_tooltip:
Sends 1 heart (3 candles each) to every friend you selected via Manage.
The candle cost is yours.
api.status_done_claim: Done! %u gifts claimed (%u candles, %u hearts), %u errored.
hearts.title: Heart targets
hearts.no_active_user: Log in to a Sky account to manage heart targets. Each account keeps its own list.
hearts.forget_confirm: Forget this account on this device? Its saved heart targets here are removed. It reappears if the account is seen again.
hearts.discard_body: You have unsaved changes. Save before closing?
ua.title: Spirit shops
ua.desc: Claims the free (cost-0) spirit-shop items the server allows - tier-1 expressions, quest checkpoints, and the Isle of Dawn starter hair. It can't unlock paid, closed, or unreleased content.
gs.title: Spell shops
gs.desc: Claims the free (cost-0) items the spell, toy and prop shops offer. Most free items are season- or event-scoped, so outside a live event this usually queues nothing - that is the normal result, not a failure.
gs.status_skipped: Skipped %u event-gated, %u already claimed this cycle
icons.tooltip:
Opens a detached window listing every registered UI icon.
Click a name to copy it to the clipboard.
dev.test_notify_body: Test notification - the HUD toast is working.
dev.test_notify_tooltip:
Fire a HUD toast now to verify the notification
system on its own.
icons.title: Icon Browser
icons.asset_error_desc: The Sky game assets aren't reachable via the mod's asset manager. This can happen on unusual launchers or if the game hasn't finished initialising yet.
butterflies.waiting_hint: Butterfly entities stream in as you explore a level.
butterflies.area_hint: Dyes appear in Forest, Wasteland, and other dark-plant areas.
butterflies.none_found: No butterflies found in this level.
butterflies.none_found_dyes: No dyes found in this level.
crab.waiting_hint: Enter an area with crabs to populate this list.
crab.empty: No crabs found in this area.
dark.waiting_hint: The plant list populates once the level finishes loading.
dark.none_found: No dark plants found in this level.
dark.burn_all_tooltip:
Sets all living dark plants to dead HP every frame.
With authority: the engine fires the death sequence and
broadcasts the result to other players next frame.
Without authority: local visual only.
dark.group_view_tooltip:
Show one row per plant, or expand to individual
branches.
crystals.hint: Red damage crystals (Eye of Eden etc.). Excluded from the Burn-all and Farm-all flows; listed here for inspection.
crystals.none_found: No hazard crystals in this level.
crystals.go_tooltip: Teleports to the crystal - will deal damage on proximity.
players.hint: Other Sky children sharing your instance - you (slot 0) plus up to 7 nearby players.
spirits.hint: Elders, spirits and NPCs the engine is tracking in this level.
avatars.restricted_tooltip:
Server-restricted - these actions are dropped before
they reach you:
avatars.befriend_confirm: Spend 1 candle to befriend this player?
relationships.no_friend_record: No friend record yet. Re-enter the level to refresh.
relationships.archived_body: They're no longer here. Sky changed how these unlocks are authorised, so the mod can't do them anymore. Unlock abilities in the game itself for now - it is one tap away. Tier ups below still work. We are working to bring this back.
relationships.tier_up_tooltip:
Raises this friend's tier once they have enough
friendship XP.
wb.waiting_hint: The wings list populates once the level finishes loading.
wb.none_found: No winged lights found in this level.
wb.collect_all_tooltip:
Instantly collect every available winged light in
this level. No teleport.
wb.drop_hint: Scatters wing buffs from your avatar.
wb.drop_unavail: Drop feature not available (pattern not resolved).
dep.none_found: No Eden statues found in this level.
dep.deposit_all_tooltip:
Instantly deposit your wings at every available Eden
statue in this level. No teleport.
dep.dormant_hint: These Eden statues are baked into the level but dormant - they activate once your account's wing buffs sync (after you log in).
rc.waiting_hint: The memory candle list populates once the level finishes loading.
rc.none_found: No memory candles found in this level.
chat.waiting_hint: Chat populates after entering a level with other players.
chat.cipher_tooltip:
Chat with other Tibik users over an obfuscated channel.
Non-mod players just see gibberish (your "Hi there" shows up as "~E1~Uv gurer").
Other Tibik users decode it automatically.
Opt-in, enable when you need it.
log.net_off_hint: Network capture is off - enable it in About > Developer.
log.paused_capture_hint: Copy and Share still capture everything, including what arrives while paused.
about.developer_desc: Diagnostics and developer tooling. If you're not sure what this is, you probably don't need it.
about.description: The frog-flavored utility for Sky. Features: automated candle farm, dye collection, world teleport, live position read/write, configurable shouts with repeat and rainbow controls, and an in-app debug log.
about.author: Author:
easteregg.no_offsets_detail: Aw, kind of you! Still, Tibik doesn't need offsets - it knows the game by heart, every version.
easteregg.no_offsets_cta: No harm either way. If you like, you can safely remove the offsets in the Canvas Mod Manager.
about.links_explanation: If Canvas update metadata ever breaks or the repo changes, these links give users a place to verify ownership, find releases, and request support manually.
about.build_mismatch: This mod was built for Sky build %u, but the current game build appears to be %u. Some features may not work reliably.
about.netlog_tooltip:
Logs every HTTP request and response (method, URL, body) at Debug level.
Off by default: bodies can contain your user/session IDs, so scrub logs before sharing.
Leave this off unless you're actively diagnosing network issues.
about.netlog_unavailable: Unavailable - the game's network functions are in use by another mod.
update.staged: Tibik %s is installed. Restart Sky to use it.
update.taking_longer: This is taking longer than expected. Hang tight!
inbox.body_features: Mod was updated. See the project page for change details.
inbox.body_features.v1.0.22: New draggable bubble icon to toggle the menu, much faster winged light collection, a live HUD during API collect (no Sky restart), plus a Drop wing buffs fix for some worlds.
inbox.body_features.v1.0.23: Reveal hidden friend statues at Home, a new Buddies tab to wake companions like Oreo the prairie dog, a Tier Up button to skip the Heart Send requirement, side-by-side support for ThatSkyMod (experimental) & SPT, plus fixes for the API collect pause and screen flicker.
inbox.body_features.v1.0.24: Compatibility bumped to Sky 0.33.8 (399977), plus a new "Join anywhere" toggle lets you join friends in restricted areas (Eden, Office, Prophecy Trials).
inbox.body_features.v1.0.25: A tidier, less cluttered UI, a type-to-filter search in the debug log, and a music player + pop-out position panel that collapse into small draggable buttons, plus an icon-browser fix so scrolling no longer copies names by accident.
inbox.body_features.v1.0.26: Unbricks a bricked game. The black screen that could strike when running alongside TSM is gone, and affected features now switch off cleanly instead of taking the whole game down with them.
inbox.body_features.v1.0.27: Set a custom profile picture for your Tibik account, and instantly deposit winged lights at the Eden statues.
inbox.body_features.v1.0.28: Compatibility bumped to Sky 0.34.0 (401861), plus teleport destinations for the new Dear Van Gogh season.
inbox.body_features.v1.0.29: API collect now leaves the game's own connection room to breathe, so Sky stays smooth and responsive while you farm in parallel - plus the game-build version nag is gone.
inbox.body_features.v1.0.30: A new Solo (offline) mode to seal yourself off in your own instance, plus a Room crash that drops everyone around you.
inbox.body_features.v1.0.31: Back up your Tibik account as a 12-word recovery phrase and restore it on another device after a wipe, the debug log now splits into separate Mod and Network tabs, the World tab adds a realm sidebar with temple markers, and you can now nickname or forget individual accounts in the Heart Targets picker.
inbox.body_features.v1.0.32: Compatibility bumped to Sky 0.34.2 (406253), plus a Winged lights option in API collect that grabs every winged light from wherever you stand, a Spawn waypoint on maps where the game defines one, and a Pause/Resume button in the debug log. More collect options now update your HUD live, and the Farm tab's Advanced sliders finally save.
inbox.body_ps: PS: dw, your inbox isn't haunted - this message is local to the mod, TGC has no idea it exists 😇
invite.title: Friend Invites (native)
invite.desc: Exercises the engine's invite requests directly. Stateless - nothing is stored. Creating an invite consumes a slot; delete it when done.
invite.bad_token: Not a valid UUID - not sent.
invite.no_slot: Request not available in this build.
auth.title: Auth Export
auth.warning: Sends {user, session} as a JSON POST to a local dev tool. These credentials grant full account control - never share them.
auth.howto: Enter your PC's IP and the tool's listening port.
auth.notif_no_session: Not logged in yet - waiting for Sky to sign in
link.help: Use one Tibik identity across devices. Share a new device's file, then Approve it on a device that is already set up.
link.export_hint: Create this device's link file and share it to another device
link.import_hint: Open a link file shared from a new device
link.merge_pick: Which one would you like to keep?
link.merge_note: The other account's nickname, avatar and history are released.
link.exported: Shared. Now Approve it on a device that is already set up.
link.err_file: That is not a valid link file.
link.err_self: That link file is from this device.
link.err_stale: Clock out of sync - try again.
link.err_rate: Too many attempts - wait a moment and retry.
link.err_replay: That request expired - re-import the file and try again.
link.err_sig: Couldn't verify the file - re-export it on the other device.
recovery.help: 12 words that bring your account back if you lose this device. Anyone who has them owns your account - forever.
recovery.warn_irreversible: Save these somewhere safe. If you lose them, no one - not even us - can get your account back. Anyone who has them can take over your account, so keep them private.
recovery.rotate_warn: This makes a NEW phrase and permanently kills the old one. Any paper with the old words becomes useless.
recovery.forget_confirm: Forget the phrase on this device? The words keep working - you'll just need them from another device or on paper.
recovery.err_wrong_order: Those are valid words but in the wrong order - check the sequence.
recovery.err_invalid: That phrase isn't valid - check the words and try again.
recovery.err_not_registered: This phrase isn't registered on the server (the account may have expired).
recovery.merge_phrase_died: Accounts merged - one recovery phrase no longer works. Check your surviving phrase and discard any other paper.
recovery.msg_created: Recovery phrase ready. Write the words down now.
recovery.msg_err_derive: Couldn't prepare the recovery key. Try again.
recovery.msg_err_server: The server rejected the request. Try again.
recovery.msg_err_network: Network error. Check your connection and try again.
recovery.reveal_elsewhere: Your phrase is on another device and can only be shown there. You can replace it with a new one here, or recover this device below.
recovery.stale_warn: Your phrase was replaced on another device - the words saved here no longer work. Make a new one, or recover.
account.body_separate: This is Tibik's own account - it can't touch your Sky login, friends, or currency.
account.body_sync: Link your devices and your Tibik settings + nickname sync across them automatically.
account.body_counts: Powers the live player count and lets the developer diagnose issues - nothing else.
account.body_manage: Rename it, or link and unlink devices anytime - right here.
account.nick_invalid: Names need 3-24 characters: letters, numbers, spaces, _ or -.
account.nick_forbidden: That nickname isn't allowed. Try another.
account.nick_reserved: That nickname is reserved. If it should be yours, contact support.
account.rate_limited: Too many requests. Try again shortly.
account.avatar_bad_image: That image couldn't be read. Try a JPEG or PNG.
